title: A feedback lead url keeps its query and fragment, so free text reaches the committed query-log store
goal: A feedback report's lead url reaches the store with scheme, host and path only: ql_distill.feedback_report drops a source_url's query and fragment before the gate, and ql_store.feedback_problems refuses a stored lead that has either, with one planted failure (a learn.microsoft.com url whose query and fragment carry prose) in the feedback_store test; querylog.md says so.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import ql_store; f=[{'outcome': 'missed', 'judged_by': 'agent', 'lead': 'https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/intune/page?note=the+docs+are+wrong#more+free+text'}]; sys.exit(0 if ql_store.feedback_problems(f, 'E1') else 1)

notes: Found by the SP-waxgh3kg fresh-context review: ql_distill.feedback_report and the gates (ql_store.feedback_problems, kb_mcp.kb_feedback) check only a lead url's scheme and host; a learn.microsoft.com url with prose in its query or fragment was stored whole as lead (probe: feedback_problems returned [] for it), and from there reaches the findings files and, for a conflict, _conflicts.md.
